name: Why is professional sewage cleanup necessary?

mainEntity.name: Why is professional sewage cleanup necessary?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional sewage cleanup is crucial because sewage contains hazardous bacteria, viruses, and other pathogens that pose serious health risks to humans and pets. Unlike clean water, sewage requires specialized procedures and equipment for safe removal and decontamination. Attempting to clean sewage yourself can lead to illness, incomplete sanitation, and potential secondary damage like mold growth. Professionals use industrial-grade disinfectants and methods to ensure the property is thoroughly sanitized and safe.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional sewage cleanup is necessary because raw sewage contains harmful pathogens that pose significant health risks, requiring specialized equipment and methods for safe and thorough decontamination.
